description:
"I think I stabbed you with a knife."

Bora brings the fallen sky home on a rainy night, and when he wakes up, he finds out that he has lost his memory. Bora wraps up such a sky that he doesn't have to search for his memories, and prevents him from leaving the dangerous house. And in the murder case that occurred on the day the sky fell, the culprit has not been found...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/guilty_pls/), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/guilty_pls), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000057913), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11669275), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230510)
